text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
WHEREAS, it is advisable to forestall difficulties and un-
necessary expenses which applicants for veteran's pension
might encounter or incur in the preparation and presenta-
tion of their applications for pension;
Now, THAREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby order:
1. An Investigating Committee on Veterans' Pension
shall be created in each municipality and chartered city
to be composed of three competent veterans in the locality,
who shall be appointed by the Chairman, subject to the
approval of the Board on Pensions for Veterans: Provided,
however, That if the required number of commatent veterans
is not available, the Chairman, subject to the approval
of the Board, shall designate as many public officials as
are necessary to complete the necessary number of mem-
bers to constitute the Committee and shall, in either case,
designate one among them as the Chairman of the Com-
2. The Committee shall hold meetings whenever neces-
sary in the nunicipal building or in the city hall, as the
.case may be, and shall be charged with the duty of
investigating applicants for veterans' pension and their
witnesses with a view to determining their rights to the
benefits provided by the pension law.
3. It shall be the duty of any officer or employee of
any branch, subdivision, agency, or instrumentality of the
Government to assist or otherwise extend his or her co-
operation to the Committee when so requested by the
latter in connection with the performance of its functions
to carry out the purpose of Commonwealth Act No. 605,
4. All officers and employees or the different branches,
subdivisions, agencies, and instrumentalities of the Gov-
ernment are likewise directed to assist in every possible
way, free of charge, any veteran-applicant who may solicit
their aid in connection with the preparation and presenta-
tion of applications for veterans' pension.
15. All Executive Orders, Administrative Orders, or parts
thereof, inconsistent with any provisions of this Order are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Aeting Assistant Executive Secretary
